purpose: show the real state of delivery against the plan, so decisions are based on facts and slippage is found early
entry_criteria: Work items are tracked in a shared tool
procedure: Define what done means for an item and a milestone, so status is judged the same way everywhere.
Take status from the tracking tool, not from memory or manual updates.
Compare progress with the plan using completed work, not effort spent, and show the trend.
Report risks, blockers and decisions needed next to the progress, with owners and dates.
Forecast the completion as a range and say what would change it.
Publish the report on the agreed schedule and record decisions taken from it.
acceptance_criteria: Status comes from the tracking tool
Forecast is a range with its drivers
Decisions needed are listed with owners

validation.check: recompute the completion percentage from the tracking tool export
check every red item has an owner and a next step

failure_modes.detection: Hours spent but items not done

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A report shows 60 percent of items complete against 70 percent planned, forecasts delivery one to three weeks late, and lists a pending decision on the payment provider with the product owner.
